name: S600P-4F-2F-DT_EN.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	S600P-4F-2F-DT
Product mame	6 Port 100M PoE Switch
Fixed Port	4*10/100Base-TX  PoE port（Data/Power） / 2*10/100Base-TX  uplink RJ45 port (Data)
PoE Ports	1 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, max 90W PoE out / 2-4 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, max 30W/port, PoE out
PoE Pin	af/at: 12+ 36- / af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+  36- 78-
PoE Bridge	max 65W
PoE Dog	support / PoE auto execution、detection and resets fault device,when PoE is on
Function	N:(Standard normal) / V:(Port isolation) / S:(Super mode)(specific port refers to user manual)
Bandwidth	1.6Gbps
Packet Forwarding	1.15Mpps
MAC	1K
Buffer	768K
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T ： Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX ： Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter)
LED Indicator	P:Power LED(over-power LED) / Uplink:(LED=10/100M Link/Act LED） / Port:(Orange=PoE LED, Green=LAN Link LED） / V:(Port isolation LED) / S:( Super mode LED)
Power	External power DC：52V 1.25A   max 68W / (100-240Vac 50/60Hz 0.9A)
Operating Temperature/Humidity	-10～+55°C；5%～90% RH Non coagulation
Storage Temperature/Humidity	-40～+75°C；5%～95% RH Non coagulation
Product /Packing / size（L*W*H）	140mm*80mm*28mm / 205mm*135mm*95mm
N.W/G.W（kg）	0.3kg/0.8kg
Lightning / Protection  level	6KV 8/20us； / IP30
Installation	Desktop (optional wall +machine hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032；CE-LVD EN62368；
FCC Part 15 Class B；RoHS；
Warranty	Whole device for 1 year(Accessories not included)
